UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Private owner-scoped settings and active reader identity binding for a signed-in Google user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

activeReaderId.description: The verified reader profile currently active for this signed-in user.

reminderEnabled.description: Whether daily behind-on-goal reading reminders are enabled.

reminderHour.description: Hour of day (0-23) for daily reading goal reminder.

reminderMinute.description: Minute of hour (0-59) for daily reading goal reminder.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server last-update timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ReadingCircle.title: ReadingCircle
ReadingCircle.description: Shared two-person reading circle coordinating Narsinh Chad and Vishwaraj Jadeja.

name.description: Display title for the shared reading circle.

ownerId.description: UID of the first authenticated member who initialized the circle.

memberUids.description: Bounded list (max 4) of authenticated Firebase UIDs belonging to this reading circle.

dailyGoalMinutes.description: Minimum daily reading minutes required to maintain a streak (30 minutes).

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server last-update timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ReaderProfile.title: ReaderProfile
ReaderProfile.description: Per-reader streak stats, daily totals map, and weekly reading summary within the shared reading circle.

readerId.description: Canonical identifier for one of the two authorized readers.

displayName.description: Full display name of the reader (Narsinh Chad or Vishwaraj Jadeja).

claimedByUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID that most recently updated this reader slot.

currentStreak.description: Current consecutive days with at least 30 minutes of reading.

longestStreak.description: All-time longest reading streak in days.

todayDateKey.description: Calendar date key (YYYY-MM-DD) corresponding to todayMinutes.

weeklyMinutes.description: Total reading minutes logged in the current 7-day window.

totalMinutes.description: Cumulative all-time reading minutes logged by this reader.

lastBookTitle.description: Optional title of the most recently read book.

dailyTotals.description: Bounded map (max 90 entries) mapping YYYY-MM-DD date keys to cumulative daily minutes.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server last-update timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ReadingSession.title: ReadingSession
ReadingSession.description: An individual reading session logged during the day that contributes to a reader's daily total.

readerName.description: Display name of the reader who completed this session.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who logged this session.

memberUids.description: Denormalized circle member UIDs enabling rule-enforced list queries.

dateKey.description: Calendar date key (YYYY-MM-DD) when the session was read.

minutes.description: Duration of this reading session in minutes (1 to 720).

loggedTimeLabel.description: Formatted local time label when the session was logged (e.g. 10:15 AM).

bookTitle.description: Optional book or article title for this session.

note.description: Optional short reflection or chapter note.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server last-update timestamp submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-scoped account preferences and active reader profile mapping.

/circles/{circleId}.description: Shared two-person reading circle membership document.

/circles/{circleId}/readers/{readerId}.description: Real-time reader streak and daily totals document for Narsinh Chad and Vishwaraj Jadeja.

/circles/{circleId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Individual reading sessions logged throughout the day by members of the circle.
